scenario: `after` capture mechanics are shared with LCCO.5 per LTAC.9.6 — the compiler reuses the `$CaptureBindings_…` fact pattern for `after` clauses. Pin: an `after` body reading the LHS binding `{s.zone}` compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowering, so which mechanism carries the binding is not observed.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    zone: String mutable

rule delayed_log:
    Sensor s where s.zone == "living_room"
->
    log info "triggered"
    after 30_s:
        log info "sensor {s.zone} delayed log"
